snippet.title: TheC64 Mini: Black Edition - A Full Game Tour
snippet.description:
Released in 2025, this particular variant of TheC64 Mini is painted black. But rather than being a simple reskin, the Black Edition has a different line-up of games, all of which being modern Commodore 64 games by indie developers.
